description:
Trigger one cross-cloud (Azure/GCP) agentless disk side-scan (#4158 Wave 2).

Tenant-scoped door for the shipped ``run_provider_side_scan`` executor: an
opt-in mutation (temp snapshot/disk create, attach, delete) that never
modifies the scanned disk or image, mounts a temp copy on an in-account
collector read-only and records SBOM + CVE + secret *metadata* only.
Credentials are never accepted here; the executor resolves scoped lifecycle
credentials from the provider chain. AWS EBS keeps its own CLI entrypoint.

account_id.description: Azure subscription id / GCP project id owning the disk + collector.
account_id.title: Account Id

collector_id.description: In-account collector VM/instance the temp disk attaches to.
collector_id.title: Collector Id

collector_resource_group.description: Azure only: resource group of the collector VM.
collector_resource_group.title: Collector Resource Group

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safe key; the same key reuses one execution record.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

location.description: Azure location / GCP zone of the temp disk (must match the collector).
location.title: Location

region.description: Optional provider region hint for client construction.
region.title: Region

target_id.description: Disk resource id, or GCE image path (target_type=image).
target_id.title: Target Id

title: SideScanTriggerRequest
